evidence_plan.requirement: methods used to reduce data sparsity effects

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to address data sparsity in neural machine translation systems, particularly for low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: Advanced methods were combined to reduce the adverse impacts of data sparsity in NMT systems.
A variant of Byte-Pair Encoding was proposed to perform effective word segmentation for Vietnamese texts, addressing the rare-word problem.
Translation units were experimented with at different levels (subword, word, and beyond) to alleviate data sparsity issues.
Byte-Pair Encoding is an unsupervised technique that has significant effects on NMT training for subword segmentation.
